callerCpuScope: Current query thread only; excludes GC, JIT and other worker threads
callerPhaseScope: Up to four bounded snapshots: query start, prefix boundary, consumption end, query end; to-prefix includes prepare/evaluate; FULL consumes prefix, RETAINED may defer reads; tail includes final exhaustion hasNext and automatic cleanup, ending before explicit result/connection close; after-consume includes explicit close and retained reads; allocation then CPU then elapsed timestamp
memoryScope: Process-authority ledger and memo metadata estimates; no separate active-query peak or whole-heap/native memory bound.
retentionRestriction: Ordered wrappers may retain consumed Values. No useful-key weak collection or physical source-decode claim.
